query:
SELECT 
                COALESCE(SUM(
                    CASE WHEN c.is_income THEN t.amount 
                    ELSE -t.amount 
                    END
                ), 0) as "net_cash!"
            FROM transactions t
            JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id
            WHERE t.user_id = $1 
              AND t.occurred_at < $2
              AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND (c.exclude_from_analysis = FALSE OR c.exclude_from_analysis IS NULL)
